name: DS Electronics, Inc.
old_description: DS Electronics has been a leader in PCB assembly and electronic contract manufacturing services since the 1990s. As a second-generation family-owned and operated company, product quality and trusted relationships in the industry are of the highest value to us.
about:
DS Electronics, Inc. was founded in the early 1990s by Don Stemple in Tempe, Arizona. Now a second-generation family-owned and operated business, the company is headquartered in Gilbert, Arizona, where it manufactures electronic assemblies for customers worldwide.

The company provides full-service electronic contract manufacturing, including PCB assembly (surface-mount and through-hole), new product development, high-volume production, box-build and electro-mechanical assembly, test engineering, and supply-chain management. Its facility runs six independent SMT lines, multiple reflow ovens with custom thermal profiling validated by a KIC profiler, pick-and-place machines capable of 0201 and fine-pitch BGA placement, two robotic selective-solder cells, a wave-solder machine, and both 3D and 2D automated optical inspection systems. The operation supports prototype runs through high-volume commercial production.

DS Electronics serves industries such as LED lighting, semiconductor manufacturers, industrial electronics, and automotive. Customers range from early-stage design teams needing engineering support to established OEMs requiring large-scale, repeatable manufacturing.

The company emphasizes product quality and long-term customer relationships, citing its engineering-led management team—including founder Don Stemple (CEO), Don Becker (General Manager), and Andy Stemple (VP of Engineering)—as a differentiator that allows it to not only build to specification but often enhance designs. Ongoing investment in advanced equipment and IPC-certified inspection underpins its quality commitment.

name: DSI Manufacturing
old_description: DSI’s goal is to establish long term partnerships with our customers. We do this by following the DSI Proven Process:
about:
DSI Manufacturing was founded in 1982 in Rogers, Minnesota. The company operates as a precision sheet metal fabrication and CNC machining firm, led by President Joe Hines. From its inception, DSI has focused on building long-term customer partnerships through a structured process it calls the DSI Proven Process.

The company runs two facilities totaling more than 80,000 square feet, housing equipment for sheet metal fabrication — laser cutting, stamping, forming, welding, and in-house powder coating — as well as CNC milling (3-, 4-, and 5-axis), CNC turning and Swiss machining, and surface grinding. A dedicated Rapid Response Cell accelerates prototypes and short-run jobs, while collaborative design-for-manufacturability services help refine parts before production. DSI handles both quick-turn prototypes and high-volume production runs across metal and plastic materials.

DSI serves industries including retail fixtures and displays, machinery and equipment, electronics and computing, communications, automotive and recreational vehicles, oil and energy, agriculture, and fluid handling and filtration. Its customer base ranges from global retailers to technology firms seeking precision metal and plastic components.

The company emphasizes its ISO 9001:2015 certified quality system, rapid turnaround via the Rapid Response Cell, and a collaborative mindset that integrates design, prototyping, and full assembly under one roof. DSI states its core focus is solving customer challenges by engineering and producing quick-turn lightweight metal products.

name: Daddy's Workshop of the Carolinas
old_description: Our lives are filled with all sorts of products, most of which come from the cogs of mass production, from a faraway land with little connection to people or place. This type of existence disconnects us from one another, how things are made & where they come from. I’d like to remedy that problem by reconnecting you to the human touch of natural materials. In an age where many things exist only in digital worlds, I hearken back to a more human time with natural wood worked & styled by a craftsman. You deserve something better than crumbling particle-board furniture. We can design from scratch, or work from a picture. I work mostly in the Craftsman & Shaker styles; furniture traditions that reflect an honest, solid way of life. Take a tour of my shop & furniture projects with the video & slideshow below. Coupled with making fine furniture, I also restore vintage machinery, with its elegant design & robust quality. From Grandma knitting in her rocker, to a child building with blocks by the fireplace, there is something deeply satisfying & richly human about creating things by hand. Join me in this long tradition of treasuring the physicality & humanness of working wood one piece at a time.
about:
Based in Lancaster, South Carolina, Daddy's Workshop of the Carolinas is operated by Joshua Pauling, who also serves as vicar, headmaster, and teacher at All Saints Lutheran Church and All Saints Classical Academy. The workshop began as a personal pursuit of hand-crafted furniture and vintage machinery restoration.

The shop produces custom furniture primarily in the Craftsman and Shaker styles, offering design from scratch or working from customer-provided images. In addition to furniture making, Pauling restores vintage woodworking machinery, emphasizing the elegant design and robust quality of older equipment. Operations are conducted on a small scale, with each piece built by hand using natural wood.

The workshop serves individual clients seeking bespoke furniture pieces and those requiring restoration of antique woodworking tools. No specific industry sectors or commercial customer types are identified in the company's public materials.

Pauling frames the work as a response to mass-produced, disposable goods, aiming to reconnect people with the human touch of natural materials and the satisfaction of creating things by hand. The venture reflects a philosophy that values the physicality and humanness of traditional woodworking.

about:
Dakota Auto Parts operates from a storefront in Sioux Falls, South Dakota. The business serves the surrounding region with a retail counter and delivery operation, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company stocks and distributes replacement parts and name-brand automotive accessories, advertising overnight availability on many hard-to-find items. In addition to parts sales, the shop provides automotive coatings and truck bed liner applications, striping and molding services, and paint mixing Monday through Friday. A shuttle service runs between local businesses, and the facility maintains regular hours Monday through Saturday.

Customers include automotive and auto body repair shops as well as vehicle owners seeking accessories to enhance appearance or functionality. The staff includes specialists in both mechanical repair and collision work, allowing the business to support professional technicians and retail buyers alike.

Dakota Auto Parts emphasizes its experienced sales team and the ability to source difficult-to-locate components quickly, positioning itself as a local resource for both routine maintenance and specialized repair needs.

name: Dakota Automotive Products, Inc
old_description: We provide a service to customers and auto dealerships in eastern South Dakota, southwest Minnesota, northwest Iowa and northeast Nebraska as an expeditor and installer of a full range of leather interiors, seat comfort products and automotive electronic accessories.
about:
Dakota Automotive Products, Inc. operates from Alcester, South Dakota, serving auto dealerships across eastern South Dakota, southwest Minnesota, northwest Iowa, and northeast Nebraska. The company's founding year and ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

The company functions as an expeditor and installer, providing a range of automotive aftermarket products including leather interiors, seat comfort systems, remote starters, rear-seat entertainment, advanced driver assistance systems, factory OE radio upgrades, SiriusXM add-ons, and power sunroofs. It supplies and installs these items for dealerships, enabling them to offer individual features that are otherwise bundled in higher trim packages.

Its primary customers are automotive dealerships in the four-state region. By acting as a distributor and installer, Dakota Automotive Products allows dealerships to sell single-item upgrades—such as a remote start or leather seating—without requiring the customer to purchase an entire option package.

The company states that its service saves customers thousands of dollars compared to factory-ordered packages, and it emphasizes providing products with the highest quality, performance, and warranty to ensure satisfaction.

name: Dana Poly Corp.
old_description: Plastic Bags & Custom Packaging Solutions That Protect and Represent Your Products
about:
Dana Poly Corp. was founded in 1990 in Dover, New Jersey, as a manufacturer of polyethylene film, bags, and sheet products. The company operates from a single New Jersey facility that has been producing plastic packaging in the United States since its inception.

The company’s core operations center on custom extrusion and converting of polyethylene resins into a wide range of products, including bin liners, box liners, drum liners, gaylord liners, pallet covers, furniture and mattress bags, anti-static bags, and construction sheeting. Its facility is strategically positioned adjacent to a dedicated rail stop that feeds resin directly into two large storage silos, and it features multiple loading bays for high-volume trailer shipments. Since 2017, the plant has been partially powered by a solar array, reflecting a stated commitment to reducing its carbon footprint.

Dana Poly serves industries such as packaging, textiles, furniture, construction, and specialized anti-static applications. Its customer base includes buyers of industrial liners, carpet and textile bags, furniture and mattress protection, and bed-bug barrier products, as well as general packaging purchasers seeking custom-printed film and sheeting.

The company emphasizes its HACCP and GMP certifications, an on-site quality control lab that conducts raw-material, in-process, and product-performance testing, and a resin development team that assists with material selection and design. Rail-direct logistics, solar energy, and high-speed printing presses are cited as factors that enable faster turnaround and cost efficiency.

name: Danco Medical Systems
old_description: Danco Medical Systems has specialized in pharmacy and laboratory design, workflow, and modular casework since 1972. Our design expertise and modular solutions will maximize your workspace and create an efficient environment conducive to your individual department’s needs.
about:
Danco Medical Systems, a family-owned business headquartered in Tipp City, Ohio, was founded in 1962 and has operated under family ownership since 1972. The company began by focusing on pharmacy and laboratory design, workflow optimization, and modular casework solutions for healthcare facilities.

Today, Danco provides a range of services including hospital pharmacy design, modular casework fabrication, IV hood selection and installation, USP 797/800 cleanroom configuration, and room sanitization systems. The firm also supplies a complete line of pharmacy cabinets, refrigerator/freezers, carts, and medication carousels from various manufacturers. Over its history, Danco has designed and equipped hundreds of facilities, supporting unit dose programs, pharmacy automation, and regulatory compliance.

The company serves hospital pharmacies, medical and dental offices, and laboratory environments. Its customers include institutions implementing USP Chapter 797 and 800 standards, adding automation to existing pharmacies, or building new cleanroom spaces. Danco’s design expertise is applied to both new construction and renovation projects across the healthcare sector.

Danco states that its mission is to deliver cost-effective, high-quality medical, pharmaceutical, and laboratory products, design, and services at the customer’s convenience. The company emphasizes its design expertise and modular solutions as a way to maximize workspace efficiency and create functional environments tailored to each department’s needs.

name: Danfe Foods
old_description: Ethically sourced from the trusted farmers, Danfe’s Chana Dal is made with the finest quality grains with no added colors, preservatives, pesticides or chemicals. Enriched with the goodness of protein, antioxidants, and magnesium, Chana dal is known to be diabetic friendly, improve digestion, boost energy, lower blood pressure, improve your heart health and more. This wholesome lentil can be used to make hearty soups, dals, delectable sweets and rice dishes that fill your home with authentic taste and flavorful aroma.
about:
Danfe Foods is headquartered in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania. The company was established by a leadership team that includes Khada Dulal as CEO and Krishna Dulal as Managing Director, supported by an advisory board and directors overseeing products, sales, operations, logistics, and finance. Driven by a passion for natural, unadulterated food, the business set out to provide families with access to quality ingredients.

The company produces a range of 100% natural food products, including lentils and beans (such as Chana Dal), stone-ground wheat flour (Atta), spices (such as white sesame seeds), and ready-to-fry pani puri. Danfe emphasizes ethical sourcing from farms and hygienic packaging designed to preserve freshness, nutrients, and purity without the use of artificial colors, preservatives, pesticides, or chemicals.

Danfe Foods serves consumers directly through its online store, as evidenced by customer testimonials praising packaging quality, fast delivery, and product variety. The brand also appears positioned for retail and food-service channels seeking authentic, natural Indian food products, though specific B2B customers are not disclosed.

The company’s stated mission is to preserve nature’s purity by offering unadulterated, wholesome foods. Danfe differentiates itself through a commitment to ethical sourcing, transparent ingredient lists, and packaging that maintains nutritional integrity, aiming to deliver “nature’s best, just the way nature intended.”

about:
Darlington Snacks operates from Indianapolis, Indiana, where it was founded in 1982 as a family-owned, privately held commercial bakery. The business has been passed down through generations, building a reputation for pre-baked, packaged snacks sold to the foodservice market.

The company produces more than 70 varieties of cookies, crackers, bars, fruit snacks, and other treats under its Appleways, Darlington, and Crave-N-Rave brands. All items are baked in a dedicated nut-free facility, individually wrapped for shelf stability, and developed through continuous recipe testing by an in-house baking team.

Darlington serves daycare centers, K-12 schools, and healthcare facilities. For daycares, it offers CACFP-creditable snacks; for schools, its products meet Buy American requirements and are free of nuts, eggs, artificial flavors, colors, and preservatives; for healthcare, the individually wrapped, dye-free items simplify tray service and patient snacking.

The bakery emphasizes innovation and convenience, positioning its nut-free, shelf-stable format as a differentiator that reduces allergen risk and labor for foodservice operators.
